name: View Ningaloo
summary: Family-run reef tours from Exmouth on Ningaloo Reef. SubSea Explorer is a semi-submersible catamaran with 16 large windows below the waterline, with one, two and three hour trips and optional snorkelling. Turquoise Girle is a power catamaran for half day snorkelling, and all tours leave from Tantabiddi Boat Ramp.
standouts: The site describes SubSea Explorer as the only semi-submersible catamaran in Western Australia
Crew hold Bronze Medallion, First Aid and Master Reef Guide certifications
Locally owned family business operating from Exmouth since 2021

contact.address: Shop 3/2 Ross St Mall, Exmouth WA 6707, Australia

trips.title: Coral Viewing Tour
trips.summary: A one hour trip on SubSea Explorer, a semi-submersible catamaran with 16 large windows below the waterline. Guests stay dry in the lower deck and watch the coral and fish go by while a marine biologist gives live commentary. No swimming is needed, so it suits young children and older guests.
highlights: 16 large glass windows below the waterline
Stays dry, no swimming needed
Live marine biologist commentary
Carpeted lower deck seating, sheltered from sun and wind

trips.title: Coral Viewing & Snorkel Tour
trips.summary: A two hour trip on SubSea Explorer that starts with coral viewing and live commentary, then a guided snorkel at one of the sites in the Tantabiddi Sanctuary. Snorkelling is optional, so non-swimmers and mixed groups can stay on board and watch through the windows. The site suggests it for young families, including babies.

Guest numbers are capped, there are two deck areas, and a light refreshment is served on the top deck before returning to the jetty.

The crew choose snorkel sites to suit the day's conditions, and a guide shares local stories on the drive. Wetsuits, all snorkelling equipment and light refreshments are included.

checkNotes: No redirect: the site stays on viewningaloo.com.au and calls itself 'View Ningaloo'. Rezdy alias 'subsea-explorer' is taken from the per-trip booking buttons on the operator's own pages; it is named after the SubSea Explorer vessel, not the business, and also carries the two Turquoise Girle tours. No Rezdy page was opened, so there are no departure times and no fares by guest type, only 'From' prices. Phone is shown on the site as 0483 206 197 (phone enquiries 7am to 9pm, 7 days; shop open 9am to 5pm). Turquoise Girle is marked 'NEW' and 'Launching in 2026' on its tour page but the 2026 blog post says it is taking guests, so its three trips are included; confirm it is running before publishing. Conflicts to check: SubSea Explorer tours do not supply wetsuits (FAQ, visitor guide) while the Turquoise Girle tours include them; the Total Ningaloo Experience length differs between pages (about 4.5 to 5 hours on tour pages, three hours in the blog); the 3 hour SubSea half day booking slug says 'approx 3.5-4hrs'. Left out of trips: a merchandise shop (13 items, not trips), the site's cancellation and refunds policy (tiered fees by notice period and special rules for cruise ship guests, not summarised here; see the terms page), a dog sitter list with private phone numbers on the FAQ, and whale shark tours (the site says it does not run them). The visitor guide says humpback whales are regularly seen from the SubSea Explorer upper deck from July to October; not repeated as a trip fact. The site makes strong claims such as 'WA's only semi-submersible glass bottom boat'; these were kept out of copy except one standout phrased as the site's own claim.
